split: out of time: trained on Aug-Sep 2018 loans, tested on Oct 2018 loans

left_out_on_purpose.State_ID, Current_pincode_ID, branch_id: Where someone lives. Can stand in for community or caste.
left_out_on_purpose.supplier_id, manufacturer_id, Employee_c: Which dealer, brand or staff member handled the loan, not the borrower.
left_out_on_purpose.Aadhar_flag, PAN_flag and other ID flags: Belong to the Identity gate. Aadhaar is voluntary, so not giving it must not cost points.
left_out_on_purpose.PERFORM_CNS.SCORE.DESCRIPTION: Repeats the bureau score as a band.
left_out_on_purpose.age_years: Age. Widened the approval gap for younger applicants for almost no accuracy gain.
